It's now available on platforms like MyClaw, OpenRouter, Novita AI, and Hugging Face, where users test it on practical jobs such as converting café floor plans to rotatable 3D previews and creating consistent character sketches with outfit details. Community experiments include tight-space layouts, multi-floor plans, and advanced procedural 3D harness builds with automated checks, highlighting its fit for scoped, repeatable design and research tasks.
